description: Aqua Monitor: Thailand (1985-2016) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. The Deltares Aqua Monitor is the first instrument that operates on a global scale, with a resolution of up to 30 metres, to show where water has been transformed into land and vice-versa. Coverage: Thailand. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Floods, Rural water supply, SDG6 Clean Water and Sanitation. It offers 2 resource(s) in wms. The portal shows 2021-01-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
